report_en: The street crew painted the step edges at {place}. They were hard to see at shift change.
The shift bell at {place} has a new striker. The crews can hear it from the lower walk again.
The watch at {place} added its dust and visibility readings to the colony archive.
The crew at {place} bolted a bench beside the shift shelter. They built it out of a packing frame.
The crew at {place} counted the unopened crates and pinned the list inside the store door.
The maintenance team logged the lubrication round at {place}. The paper copy is on the tool cabinet.
The crew at {place} replaced the faded labels before putting the sample trays away.
The crew took a second set of vibration readings at {place}. The readings are in the maintenance log.
The night crew added a reflective tag to the service gate at {place}.
The antenna crew at {place} stored a fresh calibration trace with the launch records.
The pad crew at {place} swept the joints and marked the inspection on the service sheet.
The survey marked a ledge at {place} where a crew can stand clear of the loose slope.
The survey placed a post at {place} beside the highest water mark.
A field crew stacked a cairn at {place}. Its coordinates are in the survey.
The survey photographed a band of layered rock at {place} and marked the outcrop.
A surveyor made a spare copy of the site sketch at {place}. The original stays with the crew.
The crew checked the trench markers at {place} and left a note beside the entrance.
The crew at {place} sealed the samples from the surface survey. The labels are ready to read.
